# Script introduction

The dry-niche tests (`s36`, `s37`) gave a positive but uncertain difference between obligate mutualists and their facultative relatives, which shrank once temperature entered the model. Before fitting further models, this notebook asks a descriptive question (sixth external review, 30 October 2026; `writing/research_roadmap.md`, rank 1): **within each contrast, does dryness vary independently of temperature among the places where the species occur and among the places available to them?** If dryness and temperature lie along one gradient, no model can separate a drought effect from a warmth effect without extrapolating into climates absent from the data.

**Variables (fixed in the roadmap before this analysis):** H1 warmth, annual mean temperature; H2 dry-season duration independent of temperature, the longest run of consecutive months with less than 50 mm of rain; H3 water stress, the annual climatic water deficit.

**Units:** the contrasts of `s37` built with cleaned records only (supplemented records are audited separately in `s39`): genera with eligible mutualists and facultative species, and the origin contrasts built from the tree of genera, in each accessible area.

**Diagnostics per contrast:**

1. correlations between temperature and each dryness variable among the occupied pixels and across the record-weighted background of the accessible area;
2. common temperature support: the overlap of the 5–95% temperature ranges of the mutualists' and the facultative species' pixels, and the share of each strategy's pixels inside it;
3. within 1 °C temperature bins inside the common support that hold both strategies, the pooled within-bin standard deviation of each dryness variable as a share of its total standard deviation among those pixels;
4. a flag: a contrast is **identifiable** for a dryness variable when both strategies have at least 10 occupied pixels in at least 3 shared bins and the within-bin standard deviation is at least one third of the total. These thresholds were set before the diagnostics were computed.

A full run takes about 3 min.

# Setup

## Packages

```{r load_packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(resrepo)
library(data.table)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Variables

```{r setup_variables}
bin_width <- 1                 # temperature bins (degrees C)
min_pixels_shared <- 10        # occupied pixels per strategy in shared bins
min_shared_bins <- 3
min_sd_ratio <- 1 / 3          # within-bin SD over total SD of the dryness variable
cap_quantile <- 0.95
dryness <- c(dry_run50 = "Longest run of months below 50 mm", cwd = "Climatic water deficit (mm)")
strategy_colours <- c(f = "#56B4E9", m = "#D55E00")
strategy_names <- c(f = "Facultative", m = "Obligate mutualist")
```

## Folders

```{r setup_folders}
dir_data_raw <- path_resrepo("data/raw")
dir_s01 <- path_resrepo("data/intermediate/s01_prepare_climate")
dir_s35 <- path_resrepo("data/intermediate/s35_prepare_dry_niche")
dir_s37 <- path_resrepo("data/intermediate/s37_test_dry_niche_v2")
dir_data_intermediate <- path_resrepo("data/intermediate/s38_diagnose_identifiability")
dir.create(dir_data_intermediate, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Functions

```{r load_functions}
source(here::here("code", "R", "write_table.R"))
```

```{r define_helpers}
read_monthly <- function(variable) {
  zip <- file.path(dir_data_raw, "worldclim_2.1", paste0("wc2.1_10m_", variable, ".zip"))
  files <- sort(grep("\\.tif$", unzip(zip, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE))
  rast(file.path("/vsizip", zip, files))
}
# Longest run of TRUE in a circular year of 12 months (all 12 if every month is TRUE)
longest_circular_run <- function(x) {
  if (all(x)) return(12L)
  r <- rle(c(x, x))
  min(max(c(0L, r$lengths[r$values])), 12L)
}
weighted_cor <- function(x, y, w) {
  w <- w / sum(w)
  mx <- sum(w * x); my <- sum(w * y)
  sum(w * (x - mx) * (y - my)) / sqrt(sum(w * (x - mx)^2) * sum(w * (y - my)^2))
}
save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)
}
theme_figure <- function(base_size = 9) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
          plot.title.position = "plot", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
          legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r keep_setup_objects}
setup_objects <- c(ls(), "setup_objects")
```

# Mechanism variables per pixel

The longest run of months below 50 mm, from monthly WorldClim precipitation, added to the pixel table of `s35` (which holds temperature and the climatic water deficit).

*Inputs:* s35/dry_niche_pixels.rds; raw/worldclim_2.1/ monthly prec
*Outputs:* mechanism_pixels.rds

```{r mechanism}
pix <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s35, "dry_niche_pixels.rds"))
P <- as.matrix(read_monthly("prec")[pix$cell])
pix[, dry_run50 := apply(P < 50, 1, longest_circular_run)]
saveRDS(pix[, .(cell, lon, lat, area_shelf, area, butterfly_records, bio01, dry_run50, cwd, dry_months, dry50)],
        file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "mechanism_pixels.rds"))
print(pix[, .(pixels = .N, mean_run = mean(dry_run50), cor_dry50_run = cor(dry50, dry_run50),
              cor_temp_run = cor(bio01, dry_run50), cor_temp_cwd = cor(bio01, cwd))])
```

```{r clear_mechanism, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

# Diagnostics per contrast

*Inputs:* s38/mechanism_pixels.rds; s37/ contrasts.csv, presences.csv
*Outputs:* identifiability.csv, contrast_pixels.rds

```{r diagnostics}
pix <- readRDS(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "mechanism_pixels.rds"))
ct <- fread(file.path(dir_s37, "contrasts.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))[occurrences == "cleaned"]
pres <- fread(file.path(dir_s37, "presences.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))[source == "cleaned"]
cp <- merge(ct[, .(pool_key, strategy, area, origin, contrast, scheme, species, genus)],
            pres[, .(pool_key, area, cell)], by = c("pool_key", "area"))
cp <- merge(cp, pix[, .(cell, bio01, dry_run50, cwd)], by = "cell")
saveRDS(cp, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "contrast_pixels.rds"))

diag <- rbindlist(lapply(split(cp, by = c("scheme", "contrast")), function(d) {
  b <- pix[area_shelf == d$area[1] & butterfly_records > 0]
  wb <- pmin(b$butterfly_records, quantile(b$butterfly_records, cap_quantile))
  q <- d[, .(lo = quantile(bio01, 0.05), hi = quantile(bio01, 0.95)), by = strategy]
  lo <- max(q$lo); hi <- min(q$hi)
  inside <- d[bio01 >= lo & bio01 <= hi]
  inside[, tbin := floor(bio01 / bin_width)]
  shared <- inside[, .(both = uniqueN(strategy) == 2), by = tbin][both == TRUE]$tbin
  s <- inside[tbin %in% shared]
  rbindlist(lapply(names(dryness), function(v) {
    within_sd <- if (nrow(s) > 2) sqrt(s[, .(ss = sum((get(v) - mean(get(v)))^2), n = .N), by = tbin][
      , sum(ss) / max(sum(n) - .N, 1)]) else NA_real_
    total_sd <- if (nrow(s) > 2) sd(s[[v]]) else NA_real_
    data.table(scheme = d$scheme[1], contrast = d$contrast[1], origin = d$origin[1], area = d$area[1],
               variable = v, mutualists = uniqueN(d[strategy == "m"]$pool_key),
               facultative = uniqueN(d[strategy == "f"]$pool_key),
               pixels_m = d[strategy == "m", .N], pixels_f = d[strategy == "f", .N],
               cor_occupied = cor(d$bio01, d[[v]]), cor_background = weighted_cor(b$bio01, b[[v]], wb),
               support_low = lo, support_high = hi,
               share_m_in_support = inside[strategy == "m", .N] / d[strategy == "m", .N],
               share_f_in_support = inside[strategy == "f", .N] / d[strategy == "f", .N],
               shared_bins = length(shared), shared_pixels_m = s[strategy == "m", .N],
               shared_pixels_f = s[strategy == "f", .N], within_sd = within_sd, total_sd = total_sd,
               sd_ratio = within_sd / total_sd)
  }))
}))
diag[, identifiable := shared_pixels_m >= min_pixels_shared & shared_pixels_f >= min_pixels_shared &
       shared_bins >= min_shared_bins & is.finite(sd_ratio) & sd_ratio >= min_sd_ratio]
write_table(diag, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "identifiability.csv"))
print(diag[scheme == "origins", .(contrast = substr(contrast, 1, 40), variable, m = mutualists, f = facultative,
                                   r_occ = round(cor_occupied, 2), r_bg = round(cor_background, 2),
                                   bins = shared_bins, pm = shared_pixels_m, pf = shared_pixels_f,
                                   sd_ratio = round(sd_ratio, 2), identifiable)])
print(diag[, .(contrasts = .N, identifiable = sum(identifiable)), by = .(scheme, variable)])
```

```{r clear_diagnostics, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

# Environmental space of each contrast

For each origin contrast and dryness variable: the record-weighted butterfly background of the accessible area (grey density), the occupied pixels of the mutualists and the facultative species, and the common temperature support (dashed lines).

*Inputs:* s38/ mechanism_pixels.rds, contrast_pixels.rds, identifiability.csv
*Outputs:* plot_environment_space_run.png, plot_environment_space_cwd.png

```{r plot_environment_space}
pix <- readRDS(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "mechanism_pixels.rds"))
cp <- readRDS(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "contrast_pixels.rds"))[scheme == "origins"]
diag <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "identifiability.csv"))[scheme == "origins"]
# Panel names: the mutualist genera (several genera named by the first) and the area
short <- function(x) vapply(x, function(e) {
  g <- strsplit(sub(" \\(.*$", "", strsplit(e, " vs ")[[1]][1]), " + ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lab <- if (length(g) > 2) paste0(g[1], " + ", length(g) - 1, " genera") else paste(g, collapse = " + ")
  paste0(lab, " (", sub("^.*\\(", "", e))
}, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
panels <- unique(cp[, .(contrast)])[, panel := short(contrast)]
cp <- merge(cp, panels, by = "contrast")
diag <- merge(diag, panels, by = "contrast")
bg <- rbindlist(lapply(unique(cp$area), function(a) pix[area_shelf == a & butterfly_records > 0,
                                                         .(area = a, bio01, dry_run50, cwd, w = butterfly_records)]))
bg <- merge(bg, unique(cp[, .(area, panel)]), by = "area", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
for (v in names(dryness)) {
  lab <- diag[variable == v, .(panel, label = sprintf("r = %.2f; within-bin SD ratio %.2f%s", cor_occupied, sd_ratio,
                                                      fifelse(identifiable, "; identifiable", "")))]
  fig <- ggplot() +
    stat_bin_2d(data = bg, aes(bio01, get(v), weight = pmin(w, quantile(w, cap_quantile))), bins = 40,
                show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey95", high = "grey55") +
    geom_vline(data = diag[variable == v], aes(xintercept = support_low), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(data = diag[variable == v], aes(xintercept = support_high), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_jitter(data = cp, aes(bio01, get(v), colour = strategy), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6,
                width = 0.1, height = if (v == "dry_run50") 0.15 else 0) +
    geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = -0.02, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = strategy_colours, labels = strategy_names, name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(x = "Annual mean temperature (°C)", y = dryness[[v]],
         title = paste("Environmental space of each contrast:", tolower(dryness[[v]])),
         subtitle = "Grey: butterfly records of the accessible area; points: occupied pixels; dashed: common temperature support") +
    theme_figure(8)
  save_figure(fig, paste0("plot_environment_space_", if (v == "dry_run50") "run" else "cwd"), 10, 8)
  print(fig)
}
```

```{r clear_plot_environment_space, include=FALSE}
invisible(gc())
```
